title: The normalized affine-space exceptional coefficient mate on the ordinary etale site
statement: Let $k$ have characteristic $p>0$, $\ell\ne p$ prime, $V$ a separated finite-type $k$-scheme and $\pi:\mathbf A^r_V\to V$ projection for $r\geq0$ [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions, def-sbc-affine-space]. Let $A=\mathcal O_E/t^m$, $B=\mathcal O_F/v^n$, $m,n\geq1$, be coefficient stages of finite extensions of $\mathbf Q_\ell$, and $A\to B$ a unital map [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Use ordinary etale derived categories [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], $F_R=R\pi_{!,R}$ for the standard compactification [def-amb-etale-compact-support], and its ambient right adjoint $\pi_R^\times$ normalized by vector-bundle integration [thm-amb-vector-bundle-purity]. Put $T=-\otimes_A^LB$ [def-kun-derived-tensor] and let $q:T_VF_A\xrightarrow{\sim}F_BT_{\mathbf A^r_V}$ be the canonical coefficient projection. For $L$ bounded constructible of finite Tor amplitude [def-weil-pbc-constructible-complexes, def-kun-tor-amplitude], the $F_B\dashv\pi_B^\times$ transpose $b_\pi:T\pi_A^\times L\to\pi_B^\times TL$ of $T\epsilon_{A,L}\circ q_{\pi_A^\times L}^{-1}$ is an isomorphism. Under the counit-preserving identifications $\pi_R^\times L\cong\pi^*L(r)[2r]$ it is the canonical coefficient/twist reassociation. Its transport under etale/pro-etale site equivalence is the specified smooth coefficient mate of [det-sp-reduction-exceptional].

source.place: Charts and uniqueness of transposes; the site/coefficient square is the separately cited lem-sp-et-proet-coefficient-compatibility, and the transported counit is det-sp-et-proet-adjunction-transfer.

proof.text: Obtain the finite coefficient annihilators, Noetherian base and invertible common modulus from the existing affine integration coefficient equation. The ordinary normalized twist transport and P1 data are unique, so arbitrary normalized input data give the canonical affine compactification counit. Apply affine_counit_scalar and compact scalar coherence to obtain the integration-normalization identity for the actual compactSupportMap.

The right-adjoint uniqueness counit identity normalizes gamma. Apply the inverse B-adjunction Hom bijection to the desired conjugation equation. The mate definition gives comparisonInverse followed by scalar extension of the A-counit; compact scalar coherence makes comparisonInverse the genuine inverse. Naturality of compactScalarMap at gamma_A cancels this inverse and reduces the equation to the preceding counit normalization. The mate is therefore a composite of gamma_A inverse, canonical affine scalar reassociation, and gamma_B, and hence an isomorphism.

For the site clause, form the ordinary B-adjoint transpose and compose with the given origin comparison o. The intrinsic site/coefficient pasting identity, naturality of reductionDirectImageComparison, and the two realization counit equations show that its conjugation by rightIso satisfies the defining intrinsic coefficient counit equation. Cancel the given invertible intrinsic coefficient comparison. Injectivity of the constructible B-adjunction inverse Hom bijection identifies that conjugation with c. Cancel rightIso_B to obtain the exact required site formula.
